about: Modwerk source-only Machine Pages 1.2 (irpina’s 1.1 adapted to Core 2.1) and DT Support 1.0.1 for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/dependencies.

mods.title: machine pages
mods.summary: Draws the SRC and LFO pages of the SRC machines that describe their own, and gives the render an event for machines that make or take a track's sound, so several machine mods combine. irpina's Machine Pages 1.1, adapted by sumedho to run on Core 2.1. On its own, and for machines that do not describe a page, it changes nothing the unit does.
